ui.head: aa28385d325432af5e55606de44bad8e1793665d
ui.conclusion: No remaining blocking issue in the reviewed source delta.
details: finish ACK reads status and notification from the same completed record while locked; a late finish cannot overwrite cancellation or timeout.
Unknown wait IDs return null status; native received is rejected and ready does not grant user-message delivery.
At most four active registrations, bounded 32-completion history and registration generation protect replacement connections.
Local UI cancellation does not reenter terminal invalidation while holding the display lock.
Mixed waiting episodes retain individual exact wait IDs and make finish intent visible.

reviewed_coordinator_boundaries: Real owner, exact live client and valid captured collaboration binding determine eligible user messages; display controller fields do not.
Queue reservation excludes competing waiters and ordinary claims, retains exact revisions, and releases synchronously on cancellation/drop.
Final response reauthenticates synchronously after asynchronous recipient collection; no await intervenes before each queue commit.
Authorization decisions across independent stores are not claimed to be one global transaction; queue revision and claim are atomic under the queue lock.
Only outer user_wait entries with received and matching attached user_messages represent a committed response; ready alone has no body.
Production HTTP native answer hook runs after reauthorization and accepts only successful nonduplicate native answer receipts.
Explicit wait intent and accepted native kind:answer can inject the reminder; arbitrary external assistant final responses cannot be intercepted.
Notification reports preserve user_seen:null and never assert a person read the notification.

verification.scope: coordinator on main plus 1a8; native UserWait UI, notification and local gateway not included
